Gratheon · entrance observer · phase 3

Entrance Observer

A slim 4K camera arch that hangs on the hive entrance. A short porch moves the doorway onto the landing board, so every bee crosses the counting line in view, even if it landed on the hive wall. A small opal roof keeps sun and rain off the lens, all cables run inside the right arm, and the compute sled slides out for service or upgrade. The same arch hangs on the beehive scale and the Robotic Beehive.
